review.claims: Preserved 43 slides, all branch feedback and hints; separated practice/no-answer from selection answers. Fictional distributions verified against SCENARIOS in the original runtime.
review.images: The original HTML embeds no external content images. Dynamic response tools remain live in the original; their choices and labels are transcribed. Fixed respondent distributions are preserved as a numeric table.
review.links: Source appendix references retained; exact link receipts are tracked in validation/editorial-links.json. The private ChatGPT conversation is described as provenance, not a public reading link.
